title: Screening decision row (screening/decisions.csv)
description: LIT-004-WORKFLOW-FIXES (proposed, D-027). One row per decision; append-only; the latest row per paper (stage order, then date, then file order) is the current decision. All CSV values are strings; empty string = not recorded. Validated by pubrecords.load_screening_decisions; a unit test keeps this file and the code in step. T1-A: rq_tags, record_type, biomarker_class, dim_explainability, dim_uncertainty, dim_calibration and validation_design are required for include/uncertain rows at title_abstract unless screener=rule:stage0 (D-060 (6)); enforced in code, not expressible in this per-row schema. The column dim_independent_validation is retired and rejected.

decision.description: 'not_screened' is never written: a record without a row is not screened

scope_flags.description: Semicolon-separated controlled tokens, no spaces. scope_pending_proteomics (D-057); non_metabolic_rq5_candidate (D-061, effective only when screening_criteria v1.1 is frozen). Other tokens need a separate owner decision; 'retracted' is derived by the build and is never entered here

record_type.description: Screening classification (D-028 2d); bibliographic types such as preprint are held by the derived publication_type. Required for include/uncertain at title_abstract (D-060 (6))

dim_feature_selection.description: RQ5 feature/biomarker-selection component (D-032, APPROVED - CONDITIONAL; not active for screening until its dependencies are met). Definition: research/reviews/Q-037a_feature_selection_proposal.md section 5 and research/reviews/RQ5_component_decisions_D032-D034.md

dim_classification.description: RQ5 classification component (D-036, answers Q-039; APPROVED - CONDITIONAL, not active for screening until its dependencies are met). Evidence definition: research/reviews/Q-041_decision_record_D035.md section 2; empty = not assessed, never no. Record: research/reviews/Q-039_decision_record_D036.md

validation_design.description: Strongest stated validation design (D-029 as specified in D-060 (1)); replaces the retired column dim_independent_validation, whose values are not converted. Required for include/uncertain at title_abstract (D-060 (6))

biomarker_class.description: Biomarker strand (D-058, answers Q-035). Required for include/uncertain at title_abstract (D-060 (6))
